title: 853. Minimum Cost to Hire K Workers

examples.explanation: Pick qualities 5 and 10 at rate 7 for payments 35 and 70.
The cheapest feasible trio costs about 30.67 within tolerance.
Only one choice, paid exactly the asking wage.

hints: This is a portable adaptation: return the minimum cost as a finite, double-parseable decimal string.
Sort candidates by the ratio wage / quality. Once the rate is fixed by the last person in order, earlier people are cheaper to include when their quality is small.
Scan the sorted order while keeping the `k` smallest qualities seen so far in a max-heap; the candidate cost at each step is heap-sum times the current ratio, and the best over all steps wins.
